camps.name: Dorchester YMCA Day Camp
camps.description_short: Weekly day camp at the Dorchester YMCA for ages 5-13 with swimming, art, dance, science, literacy and team-building activities; runs 7:30am-5:30pm.

sources.note: Prices are non-member weekly rates; member rates are lower. Financial assistance, EEC vouchers and contract slots handled via the camp's billing email. Page states ACA accreditation.
ZIP from the YMCA branch address where camp is held.

camps.name: Waltham YMCA Cabot Day Camp
camps.description_short: Day camp at the Waltham YMCA with groups for ages 3-4, 5-6 and 7-12; younger campers get daily swim lessons, older campers choose among activities. Hours 7:30am-5:30pm.

sources.note: Prices are non-member weekly rates; member rates are lower. Financial assistance, EEC vouchers and contract slots handled via the camp's billing email. Page states ACA accreditation. $475 for ages 3-6, $400 for ages 7-12; Caboteers (3-4) run Sessions 1-9 only, Session 10 is for ages 5-12.
ZIP from the YMCA branch address where camp is held.

camps.name: Parkway Day Camp
camps.description_short: Day camp for ages 4-6 at the Parkway Community YMCA in West Roxbury with swimming, crafts, STEAM projects and games around weekly themes. Hours 7:30am-5:30pm.

sources.note: Prices are non-member weekly rates; member rates are lower. Financial assistance, EEC vouchers and contract slots handled via the camp's billing email. Page states ACA accreditation. Page said the camp was full with a waitlist (2026).
ZIP from the YMCA branch address where camp is held.

camps.name: Oak Square YMCA Camp Walsh Day Camp
camps.description_short: Day camp at the Oak Square YMCA in Brighton for ages 3-13 with group games, swimming, STEM and creative activities. Hours 7:30am-5:30pm.

sources.note: Prices are non-member weekly rates; member rates are lower. Financial assistance, EEC vouchers and contract slots handled via the camp's billing email. Page states ACA accreditation. $475 for ages 3-6, $400 for ages 7-13.
ZIP from the YMCA branch address where camp is held.

camps.name: Camp Nansema
camps.description_short: North Suburban YMCA day camp in Woburn for ages 5-13; campers rotate weekly through arts and crafts, STEM, performance, archery, sports and swimming. Hours 7:30am-5:30pm.

sources.note: Prices are non-member weekly rates; member rates are lower. Financial assistance, EEC vouchers and contract slots handled via the camp's billing email. Page states ACA accreditation. $475 for ages 5-6 (Mini), $400 for ages 7-13 (Mighty).
ZIP from the YMCA branch address where camp is held.

camps.name: Burbank YMCA Day Camp
camps.description_short: Day camp at the Burbank YMCA in Reading for ages 5-13 with three tracks (creative arts, sports and healthy living, STEM) plus daily swimming and outdoor play. Hours 7:30am-5:30pm.

sources.note: Prices are non-member weekly rates; member rates are lower. Financial assistance, EEC vouchers and contract slots handled via the camp's billing email. Page states ACA accreditation. $575 for ages 5-6, $500 for ages 7-13 (as listed).
ZIP from the YMCA branch address where camp is held.

camps.name: Thomas M. Menino YMCA Day Camp
camps.description_short: Day camp for ages 3-6 at the Thomas M. Menino YMCA in Hyde Park, running weekly sessions 7:30am-5:30pm.

sources.note: Prices are non-member weekly rates; member rates are lower.
ZIP from the YMCA branch address where camp is held.
Day camps page: families needing financial assistance contact the billing contact in their camp guide.

camps.name: Camp Pikati
camps.description_short: West Suburban YMCA day camp in Newton for ages 3-14 with games, sports, crafts, swimming and archery around weekly themes; field trips for grade 2 and up. Hours 9am-4pm.

sources.note: $505 is the non-member weekly rate (household member $380, youth member $440). AM care $45 and PM care $65 per session. Pre camp/closing week prices not confirmed, left null.

camps.name: Camp Chickami
camps.description_short: West Suburban YMCA day camp in Wayland for youth entering grades 1-9, with archery, crafts, a challenge course, sports leagues, nature and swim lessons. Hours 9am-4pm with bus service from Newton.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Campers receive swim lessons during the week at camp.

sources.note: $510 non-member weekly rate (household member $450, youth member $490); bus fee $100/session; AM care $55, PM care $85. Pre camp/closing week prices not confirmed. LIT sessions omitted.
Street address/ZIP as listed on ACA Find a Camp; camp site only says 'Wayland off Route 20'. Town of Wayland page also lists 139 Boston Post Road. ACA accreditation not confirmed, left null.

camps.name: Camp Sewataro
camps.description_short: Day camp on 44 wooded acres in Sudbury for ages 3-15 with fishing, boating, swimming, archery, a ropes course and zip line, arts, music, gardening and sports.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Deposits ($400-$800 by session length) are deducted from tuition; half the balance is due Feb 1, 2027 and the rest Apr 1, 2027. After Feb 1 no refunds for absence, withdrawal or shortened sessions.

sources.note: Home page: ages 3-15, Extended Day program offered.
Sessions are for the Fox/Bear/Eagle/Owl groups (K-8th grade). Chipmunk (ages 3-4) runs weekly June 28-Aug 20 at $545 half day / $1,085 full day; CIT (grades 9-10) 4-week sessions $2,090.
Bus $125/week Sudbury families, $135/week others (2026 rates).
Each child brings a lunch and beverage.
Need-based scholarships limited to children of Sudbury residents.

camps.name: Camp Grossman
camps.description_short: JCC day camp on 75 acres in Dover for grades K-10 with daily lakefront swimming and boating, climbing, a zip line, sports, arts and Jewish cultural programming; buses from 30+ Greater Boston towns.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Instructional and free swim daily; Red Cross-certified lifeguards teach a modified Red Cross swim curriculum.

sources.note: Ages derived from grades K-10. Phone is the summer number. After care until 6pm at the Leventhal-Sidman JCC in Newton; bus $90/camper/week. Season runs as four two-week sessions (min. one) plus add-on weeks; individual session dates and 2026 tuition not listed, 2027 rates 'coming soon'. Campers bring dairy/pareve/fish/vegetarian lunch.

camps.name: Camp Harbor View
camps.description_short: Free day camp for Boston residents entering grades 6-9, held on Long Island in Boston Harbor; campers ride a bus from the Seaport and a ferry, and get breakfast, lunch and dinner.
camps.special_needs_notes: Camper support team with social workers offers emotional support, sensory tools and a break room.

sources.note: Ages derived from grades 6-9 (entering). Eligibility: City of Boston residents. Hours ~7:30am-5pm. Page says 2026 camp is fully enrolled.
'free to attend'.
Camp is on Long Island in Boston Harbor (no street address); ZIP is the Camp & Leadership Academy mailing address, 135 Morrissey Blvd., Boston 02125.
